hack.root_cause: Reinitializable init() function + emergencyExit() drain on token vesting contracts
hack.description: DAO Maker was exploited for $4M when its token vesting contracts allowed anyone to call `init()` a second time — resetting ownership to the attacker and enabling `emergencyExit()` to drain all funds.
